def main(argv):
    """
    Main function.
    """
        parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
        parser.add_argument('-p', '--port', help='Port number to listen to', default=8080)
        parser.add_argument('-d', '--debug', help='Enable debug', action='store_true')
        parser.add_argument('-r', '--root', help='Root directory to serve', default='.')
        args = parser.parse_args()
        print('Serving directory {} on port {}'.format(args.root, args.port))
        if args.debug:
            print('Debug mode enabled')
        run(host='localhost', port=args.port, debug=args.debug, root=args.root)


    if __name__ == '__main__':
        main(sys.argv[1:])</s>
